raw_sections.summary: Seeking a challenging position and growth within the organization that may fully utilize my potentials based on my vast experience and pave way for a thorough professional. My profile fits into Investment Banking operations.
raw_sections.experience:
Work experience summary:
Working as an Independent  Consultant, Career Counsellor and a Trainer for Investment Banking Concepts, New joiners Independently training students :  July 2024 till date 
Having associated with Learning institutes like Imarticus Learning and Mentor Me careers for teaching students on IB concepts, time management, Escalations and overall personality development.
Delivering introducton training on IB, Designing specific training for need based demands from companies, learning and development , training and development, organisational development, training need analysis, financial crime,new hire training, OD interventions and Training Delivery.s
As a value add, financial discipline and personal investment horizons are also discussed paving way to the art of making money.
Flexible to take on any assignments and open to work in organisations full time too if given an opportunity.
Duties and Responsibilites
1. Developing Learning Strategies
2. Designing and Implementing Training Programs
3. Evaluating Training Effectiveness
4. Managing Budgets
5. Collaboration with stake holders
6. Creating Individual Development Plans
7. Compliance and Reporting.
8. Taking spot Introduction classes for a peek into IB world and engaging audience to the                               next level of career building.
Worked in Broadridge India financial solutions as a Process Manager/Product Manager from July 2022 till June 2024 ,
Managed a team of 120 members, daily work allocation, escalation management
Training new joinees in financial risk management, time management, mark to market, cut offs and Escalations
Root cause analysis of Errors and fixing control gaps and document preparation for wide awareness as no scope of repetitions
Verifying high value payments, reviewing SOPs, client relationship meetings, new business calls
Recruiting suitable candidates as per attrition and new businesses
Main focus on improving process by way of macros, implementation of solid ideas into system improvements enabling time and cost benefit to client
Cross training resources is a key role for maximum employee utilisation
Motivating best performers and tutoring slow learners is an essential role so that we have balance in team
Performance appraisal, setting career goals for team members
Monitoring KPIs , KRAs and SLA  for best results and overall capacity.
Vendor Management supports and meetings to be attended for proper delegation and support of processes to be given.
Third Party risk management
Deputy Manager , Wipro LTD , working for client (UBS ). ( July 2007 to July 2022). 15 yrs
Delivered in-depth training to users for different applications, imparting knowledge of best practices for protecting data and minimizing errors.
Investigated and addressed system issues to enhance usability and improve functionality.
Followed up with clients to ensure optimal customer satisfaction following support engagement and problem resolution.
Liaising work with client data such as in client on-boarding, client contracts and client relationship management
Performing data analysis (e.g., consolidation of similar data from multiple sources and identifying differences, making recommendation on which to select)
Working on data operating model associated with data cleansing (e.g., ability to articulate how data cleansing work for a given account attribute)
Monitor the ALERT system and FXALL system and determine the impact, if any, to the settlement instructions to the third party banking customers.
Actively participated in Agile ceremonies, such as Sprint planning, Retrospective and daily stand-up meetings.
Manage trades & its life cycle for different type of Capital Market products like Equity, Fixed income, FX, Forwards, Repos.
Preparing functional requirement documents, BRD, taking approvals for sprint process, budget approval for preparing various documents and also tested various applications during my stint at Wipro.  I have done 4 automations related to settlements and hence interested in this position.
Provide training both classrooms based and practical to new joiners including buddying up to give them understanding of process and ability to work independently.
Triparty settlements, Inventory management between clearstream and euroclear, Grading collateral , instrucing principal adjusments and adhering to triparty agreements
Work on various Internal & MS Applications to generate reports and update date to intimate onshore on daily and weekly basis.
Escalating trade discrepancies to front office, counterparties and resolving them.
Responding to settlement inquiries received from Custodian, Traders & Brokers via calls, Chats and emails.
Handling S-1 , S Queues , Mail box management , Making Payments within stipulated currency cut offs, Fails Management and Prioritizing High value Nominal, Proactively offering partials to clients , in case of high nominal to mitigate risk. Preparing Bond borrows Report and High Risk Fails report.
Liaising with traders for firm shorts and sensitive clients.
Liaising with reconciliation team to solve aged breaks , user stories creation.
Handling escalation calls and emails from client and covering risk.
Defaulting static data and paving way for automation increasing stp of process, also mapping of ssis to products based on client behavior.
Updating Onshore and Offshore management of any risk involved or any error detected to avoid any further loss.
Root cause analysis and control points for all the possible errors occurred.
Reviewing SOP and updating any changes and taking sign off from management
Reviewing Bond borrow report , reconciliation report of nostro and depot breaks
Buy in Management, Position Management , Mail box management and Leave management.
Investigation and audit trail of all breaks and evidencing.
Engaged in SSE NG Project and TLM project acting as an interface between IT and Operations, worked in UAT environments and assisted in projects go live.
Domain expert and a trainer for new joinee in general concepts before they start processing.
Past Experience:
HSBC Ltd( Dec 2005 to July 2007) : Worked as a finance executive in core nostro reconciliation, reconciling ledgers and statements for Hong Kong region.
PGDBA from Symbiosis, Pune in Jan 2009
M.Com from Andhra University in June, 2003.
PG Diploma in Taxation from Osmania University in April, 2003.
B.Com from Osmania University in March, 2001.
raw_sections.awards:
ACHIEVEMENTS
Received individual appreciations from both Wipro and Client management for acting as an SME and risk mitigation.
Trained 220+ new joiners during my tenure and a good communicator.
Delivered a 60 minute benefit daily to business, by assisting to create macro with IT team
Twice travelled to London for business migration purposes and achieved BAU as per the prescribed time lines.
